messages:
Maria (CS): Quick weekly check-in for Saffron dedicated pool — seeing a persistent queue depth rise overnight, GPU hours +48% week-over-week, P95 latency up ~120ms. Putting notes here for ops/eng.
Aj (Ops): Thanks. I grabbed the overnight graphs — queue depth peaked at 38 (normal ~12). Burst window around 02:30 UTC. Links: https://dash.rewind/saffron/pool and a quick snapshot below.
Kevin (Eng): Can you paste the specific model(s) hitting the pool? Might be a heavy quantized variant rollout.
Maria (CS): Customer ran a big data-parallel onboarding job + continued low-latency traffic. Top models: saffron-base-v2 and saffron-qa-v1. QA variant did a rolling deploy yesterday.
Aj (Ops): Snapshot (02:15-03:15 UTC):
```
pool: saffron-dedicated-1
GPU_hours_day: 620 (avg 420)
queue_depth_peak: 38
avg_latency_p95: 420ms (baseline 300ms)
error_rate_5xx: 0.7% (baseline 0.1%)
```
Aj (Ops): Also saw sustained KV cache misses — prefix caching not effective for the onboarding job.
DeployBot: [ALERT] Canary deploy saffron-qa-v1 completed 2024-11-12T02:10:08Z. No automatic rollback.
Kevin (Eng): Noted. That canary timeframe matches the spike. Early suspicion: a subtle change in attention fusion causing slower per-token kernel time at sequence lengths >1024. I'll roll a perf probe on a mirrored node.
Linda (CSM): Customer is on a renewal cadence in 6 weeks. Need to capture this incident in the risk log and loop in their platform lead. I'll draft a customer note but want a fix path first.
Aj (Ops): Mitigations in the short term: 1) enable burst-capacity (add +2 nodes) — low friction; 2) limit onboarding batch concurrency to 4; 3) enable prefix caching override for onboarding job. Which should we prioritize?
Kevin (Eng): Prioritize 1 and 3. I can deploy a kernel patch to the canary in ~2 hours; if perf improves on the probe node we'll roll.
Maria (CS): I'll ask the customer to throttle the onboarding job concurrency and schedule a 30-min triage at 10:00 UTC so we can present numbers. Linda can you send calendar?
Linda (CSM): On it. I'll propose 10:00 UTC and include their infra lead + product manager.
Aj (Ops): I turned on burst-capacity for saffron-dedicated-1 (temp +2 nodes) — monitor shows queue depth down to 14 in the last 4m. Keeping an eye on cost impact.
Kevin (Eng): Probe results (03:20 UTC): saffron-qa-v1 on probe node shows 18% slower kernel time vs baseline at seq>1024. Rolling a hotfix to reduce the expensive fusion path.
Maria (CS): Good — can we get an ETA for hotfix roll? Customer will want reassurance.
Kevin (Eng): Hotfix build + canary deploy in ~45 minutes. If metrics clear in 30m post-canary we'll roll fully.
Linda (CSM): Noted — I'll tell Saffron we have a remediation plan and an ETA ~1.5hrs for canary then monitor. They appreciate transparency.
Aj (Ops): FYI cost delta while burst nodes are live: ~+$1.3k so far. I'll coordinate with finance for temporary chargeback if needed.
Maria (CS): Action items: Kevin -> hotfix + perf probe (inflight). Aj -> keep burst up until canary validated + track costs. Linda -> send invite + customer note. I'll update the weekly account health doc after triage.
Kevin (Eng): Hotfix canary up at 04:05 UTC. Initial micro-bench looks good: p95 down ~90ms on probe.
DeployBot: [INFO] Canary deployment saffron-qa-v1-hotfix started 2024-11-12T04:05:12Z.
Aj (Ops): Production metrics trending: queue depth stable 10-15, p95 trending back toward baseline. Keeping burst nodes until end of day unless rollback needed.
Linda (CSM): Customer call scheduled 10:00 UTC — adding the triage notes and action items.
Maria (CS): Thanks team — keep this thread updated with any regressions. I'll mark renewal risk as Monitor (not Critical) for now. :white_check_mark:
